text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Aww, thanks! You should totally come too, 
Yaeno-chan! To my birthday party— "Maruzen 
Night Fever"♪

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
It is the greatest honor. I have heard 
that countless guests gather every year 
for your birthday party, Maruzen-san.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
So many people look up to Maruzen-san and 
gather around her. That is truly how the 
strong ought to be.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. I'm happy you're celebrating with 
me, but— there are even more wonderful 
things in store, you know?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
If it's a party, you can grandly entertain 
everyone who supports you, helps you out, 
and your friends, right?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Have fun to the fullest, eat delicious 
food —and wrap it all up with high-energy 
dancing on the podium.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Making everyone happy like that is the 
greatest joy... I guess☆

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my word...! Not content with merely 
being celebrated, but returning blessings 
to everyone instead!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...The Master said: A true martial artist 
never boasts of their prowess, and always 
treats others with sincerity. That is the 
spirit of 'Gekishinbu'—

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
This unworthy Yaeno has caught a glimpse 
of Maruzen-san's true strength, and I am 
thoroughly convinced... Osu!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. It might be a bit of an 
exaggeration, but... that bodacious sense 
of yours is totally chogoberigoo!
